d.ko:
Tactical dice-rolling roguelike combat.
Take control of 5 heroes, each with their own unique dice. Fight your way through 20 levels of monsters and try to take on the final boss. If you lose a single fight you have to start over so be careful (and lucky!).

d.zh: 战术掷骰 × Roguelike 战斗！集结 5 位拥有独特骰子的英雄，穿越密布怪物的20个关卡，直面最终 Boss。一败即重来——既要步步当心，也要有爆棚的好运！

rv.t: 단순한데 재미있음. 볼륨이 더 있었으면 하는 바람이 있음.
주사위 굴리는 맛이 아주 찰져요 슬앤다 갤 가면 한국어 패치도 있어서 굿 감칠맛이 참 좋은 게임
This is, probably without exaggeration, the greatest game ever made in terms of design, mechanics, and literally infinite replayability. On top of that, it's endlessly and easily mod-friendly. …
I only have 6 hours on this game because I have already played unhealthy amounts of it on my phone it's so peak, and Zaggurath cooked so hard with the music.
在有了汉化之后，这游戏已经加入了我心目中rougelike游戏的T0梯队，强烈推荐
类似小队叠BUFF做选择的电子桌游，手机玩更舒服，本身内容就不少，还能随机组合词条生成随机怪物、英雄、道具等内容，也能在网上复制别人做的模板游玩
